products.title: DayFlex Multiway Fold Waist Cycling Shorts - Cool Espresso
products.body_html:
You LOVE our Multi-way Fold Waist Wide Leg Yoga Pants so, of course, we had to recreate her for summer in our Cycling Short style. Bodies change daily, and an adjustable waist means you control the comfort. Our Dayflex collection is crafted using 75% Recycled Nylon for durability and strength (saved from waste) and 25% Lycra for the perfect 4-way stretch.

  • Centre back embroidered TALA logo 

  • Leg shaping as per Dayflex Flare 

  • Multiway fold over waist - can be worn low waisted

  • Inseam length - 11.5cm as per size Small

  • Consciously created with sustainability in mind, made from 75% recycled nylon and 25% LYCRA® SPORT

 

Responsibility:

This item is made from Recycled Nylon from pre-consumer waste (aka factory offcuts) certified by the Global Recycle Standard. 

  • Average impact savings vs. virgin Nylon = Co2 emissions reduced by up to 76%.
  • Audited, Ethical Factories: Ethically Made in China. For more information visit here
  • WRAP (Gold) certification for responsible production. 
  • Sedex-SMETA audited for worker health and safety. 
  • Oeko-Tex Standard 100 tested and certified for no harmful substances.


Treat me with care... 

All TALA items are made to last. By caring for our clothes we prolong their life, so they can be worn, over and over again.

  • Turn inside out to wash
  • Wash dark colours separately
  • Delicate machine wash at  30°C
  • Do not bleach
  • Do not tumble dry
  • Do not iron
  • Do not dry clean
  • Can be steamed to remove creases

    Model info: 

    Elissa // UK 8 // Tala size XS // 5’9

    Impact information based on secondary data. Correct at the time of publishing.
